screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.hive_help: Hive: primary bee above; companion bee below. Original addon item filters apply.
screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.climate_help: Climate: biome temperature and humidity; gravity and tolerance need backend support.
screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.output_help: Products: output only. Use arrows to see all output slots; Sort reorders outputs safely.
screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.frame_help: Frames: insert compatible apiary frames in unlocked housings. Hatched slots are unavailable.
screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.modifier_hel: The runtime menu reports actual productivity. Productive Bees exposes endurance and weather tolerance, not native lifespan, mutation or territory alleles.
screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.ledger_detai: Primary bee: upper slot. Companion bee: lower slot. Frames: lower housings. Outputs: right grid. The runtime genome view reports verified Productive Bees traits when available.
Temperature and humidity are real biome readings. Heater, fan, humidifier, dryer and bee tolerance data are not supplied yet; module lamps stay off.
The runtime controller enables FE and an 8,000 mB honey tank at tier 3; a 4,000 mB Liquid Starlight catalyst tank unlocks at tier 6. Lower-tier wells remain sealed.
Output pages preserve existing products and legacy recovery slots. Sort compacts on the server; eject respects adjacent inventory capacity. Voiding requires an explicit Shift confirmation.
screen.zerog_tweaks.alveary.reserved_det: Sealed: this addon does not supply lifespan, gravity-tolerance, energy or fluid-tank data.

message.zerog_tweaks.signal_heard: The Nullifite hum changes. Far above, an ancient relay is listening. Return to the Overworld at night.
message.zerog_tweaks.courier_arrived: A Concord Courier fell nearby at X %s, Z %s. The Moon has answered your signal.
message.zerog_tweaks.courier_console: Refuge signal received. Courier dispatched. Rebuild the gate. We are waiting.
message.zerog_tweaks.courier_claim_adapt: Courier delivery is paused: this server's claim system needs a verified protection adapter. Ancient-city chests can still hold a Dormant Wisp.
message.zerog_tweaks.lunari_signal_greet: Lunari: You are the one who answered the signal. We tended the relay for thousands of years. Welcome, traveller.
codex.zerog_tweaks.signal:
THE SIGNAL
Earth was our refuge. Our Pathfinder crashed deep in its rock. Its gate core became the humming Nullifite. The Moon relay heard you. This Courier carries Echo, our sleeping navigator.
codex.zerog_tweaks.template:
BUILDER'S TEMPLATE
Build a Gate Controller around the Dormant Wisp. Pattern:
Ingot / Tinted Glass / Ingot
Redstone / Nullifite Frame / Redstone
Ingot / Dormant Wisp / Ingot
Echo will do the hard part.
codex.zerog_tweaks.coordinates:
AWAITING COORDINATES
Echo's memory is shattered. T1 holds two coordinates: the Moon relay and the Mars waystation. The Lunari wait for the one who answered. Seek the Rustborn's hand-cut Aresite core on Mars.
